questions: how can I track my order
answer: You can track your order from your account's Orders section using the tracking number provided after shipment.
Standard delivery usually takes 3–7 business days after dispatch. Actual delivery time can vary by location.
To return an eligible item, open your order details and select the return option. Keep the item and packaging ready for pickup.

questions: when will i get my refund
answer: Refund timing depends on the payment method. Once a refund is approved, it may take several business days to appear in your account.
Please check your card details, available balance, and internet connection. You can also try another supported payment method.
Please provide your order ID when contacting support so the team can assist you faster.
